surfaces.title: Environment and authentication isolation
surfaces.description: Managed factories must have isolated environment variables, credentials, and auth scopes so one factory cannot read or mutate another factory's runtime identity.
evidence_requirements: factory-fleet status evidence showing per-factory identity boundaries
host lifecycle checks confirming scoped credential materialization and cleanup
surfaces.failure_message: Rollout blocked: env/auth isolation evidence is incomplete or isolation boundaries regressed.

surfaces.title: Fleet visibility
surfaces.description: Operators must be able to inspect managed-factory health, active work, and recent failures from deterministic ops interfaces.
evidence_requirements: fleet status output covering running and recently failed factories
tick status and outcomes evidence proving observable progress and failure surfaces
surfaces.failure_message: Rollout blocked: fleet visibility does not provide complete health and outcome coverage.

surfaces.title: Same-machine host lifecycle
surfaces.description: Factory host start, stop, restart, and health transitions must be deterministic on a shared machine without manual state surgery.
evidence_requirements: host lifecycle command evidence for start/restart/health paths
recovery sweep evidence proving stale ownership and dead-process cleanup
surfaces.failure_message: Rollout blocked: same-machine host lifecycle is not yet deterministic or recoverable.

surfaces.title: Incident packet quality
surfaces.description: Failures must emit incident packets with actionable context so control-plane triage can classify cause, route remediation, and prevent recurrence.
evidence_requirements: incident packet validation output with required fields
sample incident packet artifacts linked to concrete run failures
surfaces.failure_message: Rollout blocked: incident packets are missing required evidence or remediation context.

surfaces.title: Model policy and benchmark readiness
surfaces.description: Model selection, fallback policy, and benchmark evidence must be explicit so semantic jobs run on approved models with measurable quality.
evidence_requirements: model policy contract evidence for reviewer and judge routes
benchmark or readiness artifacts for configured production models
surfaces.failure_message: Rollout blocked: model policy or benchmark readiness evidence is incomplete.

surfaces.title: Operator onboarding and runbook completeness
surfaces.description: An operator with no local context must be able to start monitoring, interpret outcomes, and execute recovery runbooks without ad-hoc tribal knowledge.
evidence_requirements: operator runbook coverage for monitoring cadence and failure routing
onboarding checklist evidence that references current ops commands
surfaces.failure_message: Rollout blocked: operator onboarding or runbook guidance is incomplete for external-factory operations.

surfaces.title: Pause, quarantine, and retry ergonomics
surfaces.description: Operators must have deterministic controls to pause dispatch, quarantine unhealthy factories, and retry safely with explicit state transitions.
evidence_requirements: control-state command evidence for pause/quarantine/retry/resume actions
lifecycle gate evidence showing control actions are enforced before resume
surfaces.failure_message: Rollout blocked: pause/quarantine/retry controls are missing, unsafe, or non-deterministic.

surfaces.title: Policy template completeness
surfaces.description: Factory policy templates must fully define required governance, QA, and operating contracts so new external factories inherit safe defaults.
evidence_requirements: template contract checks proving required policy sections are present
scaffold validation evidence that generated factories receive policy defaults
surfaces.failure_message: Rollout blocked: policy templates are incomplete or do not enforce required contracts.

surfaces.title: Release targeting and resume visibility
surfaces.description: Operators must be able to verify target release assignment and inspect resume eligibility/status for each managed factory.
evidence_requirements: release targeting status evidence for each managed factory
resume gate evidence exposing why a factory can or cannot resume
surfaces.failure_message: Rollout blocked: release targeting or resume visibility is incomplete.
